verdicts.reason: A leaves the bottom ~45% of the canvas empty, with everything crammed into the top half. The bottle spills out of the left side of its circle, the decorative circle floats with no purpose, and the CTA sits off its own axis, not lined up with the headline. B fills the square with a strong headline, but the bottle cap touches the top edge and the faint circle is clipped in the corner. The NEW badge is blown up until it competes with the Try It button, the two buttons have mismatched widths, and the right-aligned buttons don't share an edge with the left-aligned headline.
